propositions: Open or in-progress bugs with caused_by edges pointing to an epic or its descendants must deterministically block epic close, with teaching message to fix, re-parent, or dispute the link.

Candidate filter must enumerate open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition OR linked (any relation, any depth, bidirectional) to the epic subtree, up to 32 candidates with overflow recording.

Haiku relevance screen must ride model-class config with shared cache settings, perform single-turn forced-choice verdicts (A/B/C), and forward at most 8 compact A-verdicts as a fenced block to the verifier's assembled context.
Verifier must block only undispositioned deliverable-defects, satisfiable by stored supersedes/duplicates links or reasoned pre-existence/deferral prose (not bare 'out of scope' or close_class).
Screen output must use registered epic_bug_screen_verdict schema with normalizing validator (default coercion to C); screen failures degrade open without blocking; DET floor is the hard block tier.

Three-stage gate (DET floor + candidate filter + haiku screen + verifier disposition adjudication) must distinguish real at-close defect escapes from legitimate deferrals and pre-existing bugs, proven against regression fixtures via live calibration.
